types.label: Fires
types.blurb: Fires in the 2026 war: every fire at a town on a day an Israeli military attack is documented there (white phosphorus, incendiary munitions, illumination flares, or a fire lit by an explosion), and every fire in the yellow-line zone or round Beaufort Castle, whatever lit it. Fires are known from satellites (NASA FIRMS, Copernicus EFFIS), from the reports of the same day, or from both; a burned area is measured, on Sentinel-2 or by EFFIS, for part of them.

types.label: White Phosphorus
types.blurb: White phosphorus munitions fired over South Lebanon, each attack built from the reports of its day, with footage and satellite detections where they exist. A geolocated attack was placed on the ground; one not geolocated is shown at its village.

types.label: Forced Displacement Orders
types.blurb: Evacuation and displacement orders issued over South Lebanon: who was told to leave and by what means the order reached them.

types.label: Detonations and Demolitions
types.blurb: Controlled detonations and demolitions of buildings, read from social-media footage and press reporting, each source's publication date checked against the day of the record.
